notes.title: 50% discount to celebrate our newest game, Pixel Galaxy!
notes.notes:
Hey folks, to celebrate the release of our newest game, Pixel Galaxy, we're dropping the price of Luna's Wandering Stars for the next week! 

Pixel Galaxy is a shoot 'em up where you turn enemies into friends. In the game, you have the ability to collect all your enemies to grow the size and power of your own ship! Check it out here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/370480/

notes.title: Level Editor Released!
notes.notes:
[b]Editor Release![/b]

With the power of the universe in your hand, craft custom levels in our fully featured level editor! Wielding the same tools as the developers, you can recreate any level in the game, or simply chase your own inspiration. What will you create in the realm beyond the stars?

Mines, wormholes, and deathwalls, oh my! With all the collectibles from the game, and the planets of the solar system, create crazy gravitational puzzles, or action-pack challenges. Over 30 real and fictional moons are ready to wield the 9 different powers of the game in an effort to best the gauntlets you imagine.

[b]Full Control[/b]

Right click on my object to bring up and modify its properties. From the radius, mass, and rotation to accurate inputs of position and velocity, you'll have the control necessary to set up any 2D orbital simulation you please. Choose the music, speed up or slow down time in the level options, and even provide an introduction or hints for anyone trying out the level.

There are intuitive tools for setting the position, velocity, and rotation of objects or groups of objects. Select multiple objects with shift, whether one by one or with a simple box selection. Test out your level, and see what you can make! We can't wait to see what you come up with!

[i]Online sharing of levels is coming soon![/i]
